title: Verifier-driven representation learning with factorized product-key routing
question: Can post-execution verifier feedback improve a learned representation enough for the existing factorized product-key index to retain useful state retrieval while keeping the inference shortlist bounded?
hypothesis: Verifier-driven contrastive updates will improve held-out target retrieval relative to outcome-only dense updates, and the learned representation can be sparsified by factorized product-key routing without requiring exhaustive inference scoring.

arms.name: dense_outcome_only
arms.intervention: dense RepresentationEnergyRouter with success-only outcome update

arms.name: dense_verifier_feedback
arms.intervention: dense VerifierDrivenEnergyRouter with post-execution repair positives and rejected hard negatives

arms.name: productkey_verifier_feedback
arms.intervention: same verifier-trained representation with 3-factor factor16 beam7 index and max shortlist 32

capability_rule: Report all endpoints by M. No sublinear claim unless routing work itself is shown to grow sublinearly with M.
non_claims: sparse execution fraction is not equivalent to sublinear addressing
index build cost is measured separately from query cost
verifier repair uses post-execution hidden target information and therefore is not a pure binary reward signal
results on this synthetic workload do not establish universal reasoning

decision_rule.condition: Compare all three arms at every registered M; report primary and diagnostic endpoints without selecting an outcome-dependent best arm.
decision_rule.licenses: a workload-specific comparison of learning signal and routing mechanism.
decision_rule.does_not_license: universal routing improvement, asymptotic scaling, or hardware speedup.

decision_rule.condition: A sparse arm may be called compute-efficient only when its measured inference routing work and build/amortization assumptions are both explicitly reported.
decision_rule.licenses: the measured cost decomposition for this workload.
decision_rule.does_not_license: sublinear addressing unless routing work grows sublinearly with M.

held_constant: candidate population construction and held-out target code set
three task-independent target codes and training-only 48-code codebook
product-key index is inference-time routing; dense verifier scoring is training-only
